verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a catalog of auditor-vetted native integrations that collect compliance data automatically and feed evidence requests and continuous monitors. Connected tools explicitly include AWS, Azure and GCP, and an IP-allowlisting article supports daily or ad-hoc refreshes. The evidence names only cloud providers, though, and never mentions read-only permission scopes. Missing for 10: evidence of identity, HR, code-hosting, MDM and ticketing integrations; documentation of read-only scopes or least-privilege permissions per integration; independent or hands-on corroboration.
